list_SUPPORTED_TASKS: list the supported miniwob tasks from the SUPPORTED_TASKS frozenset constant
check_task_in_SUPPORTED_TASKS: check if a miniwob task name is in the SUPPORTED_TASKS frozenset
get_SUPPORTED_TASKS_count: get the count of supported miniwob tasks from SUPPORTED_TASKS
iterate_SUPPORTED_TASKS: iterate over the SUPPORTED_TASKS frozenset to process each miniwob task name
filter_SUPPORTED_TASKS: filter the SUPPORTED_TASKS frozenset for tasks matching a pattern like click or drag
